worktrees.title: Git Worktrees
worktrees.desc: Work on multiple branches simultaneously without stashing. Bough manages all your worktrees from one sidebar.

subscription.title: Own It Forever

native.title: Native, Not Electron

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Is it really a one-time payment?
faq.a1: Yes. Pay €29 once and Bough is yours forever. You'll receive all updates for the current major version (v1.x) at no extra cost.
faq.a2: Bough enters read-only mode — you can still browse your repository history and diffs, but write operations (commit, push, pull) require a license.
faq.q3: Can I use it on multiple machines?
faq.a3: Yes. One license covers 2 activations — perfect for a work and a personal machine.
faq.a4: Only to push/pull from remotes (like any git client). License validation is offline. The only online check is a one-time revocation check ~130 days after purchase.
faq.q5: What if I need Linux support?
faq.a5: Bough is distributed as an AppImage on Linux, which runs on any modern distribution without installation.
faq.q6: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a6: All major credit and debit cards via Stripe. Apple Pay and Google Pay where available.
